nodes.label: request_caregiver_input escape hatch
nodes.rationale: A run with zero calls on a sparse upload is a red flag; the tool is the model refusing to guess.

nodes.label: Rule F-1: no model call during a patient session
nodes.norm_label: rule f-1: no model call during a patient session
nodes.rationale: Keeps sessions byte-for-byte deterministic so baselines stay comparable and check:offline meaningful.

nodes.label: Rule F-2: agent proposes, never commits
nodes.norm_label: rule f-2: agent proposes, never commits

nodes.label: Simulation mode panel (not camera data)
nodes.rationale: Never starts automatically, including when camera or model fails; frames flagged simulated.

nodes.label: head_facing_score heuristic
nodes.rationale: Head orientation is not eye gaze; no signal establishes engagement, emotion or cognitive state.

nodes.label: Suggested actions (delay_instruction, gentle_cue, offer_hint, increase_difficulty)
nodes.rationale: No rule lowers difficulty; difficulty depends only on task performance.

nodes.label: task_engagement_score heuristic
nodes.rationale: Not validated; do not use for decisions about a person.

nodes.label: tracking_quality heuristic
nodes.rationale: Face Landmarker gives no per-face confidence, so none is invented.

nodes.label: Session WebSocket protocol (hello, roles, close codes)
nodes.norm_label: session websocket protocol (hello, roles, close codes)

nodes.label: Actions are suggestions; game decides
nodes.rationale: Game must be fully playable without the service; stale state is 'unknown', never 'looking at the screen'.

nodes.label: Offline setup mode (llama-server, Gemma 3 4B)
nodes.rationale: Privacy property rather than policy: photographs never leave the device as a fact about the network path.

nodes.label: Online setup mode (gemini-3.5-flash-lite)
nodes.rationale: Trades the network path for accuracy and no install; exactly one destination and nothing sent without a key.

nodes.label: Degradation contract (fallback has a fallback)
nodes.rationale: 'Always works' means the scene renders and mission completes with zero network assets.

nodes.label: Memoria 3D Deployment (incomplete)
nodes.rationale: No Vercel/Netlify credentials or interactive login in the build environment, so deploy was left as documented manual steps.

nodes.label: CSP allowances (dl.polyhaven.org, generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
nodes.rationale: Restrictive CSP blocking Poly Haven triggers the §1.1 fallback; blocking Gemini breaks only online mode.

nodes.label: Never set VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY for hosted builds
nodes.norm_label: never set vite_gemini_api_key for hosted builds
nodes.rationale: Vite inlines every VITE_ variable into the shipped bundle, exposing the key to anyone loading the page.

nodes.label: vite.config base './'
nodes.rationale: Relative base lets the build work from a subpath or root domain without changes on either host.

nodes.label: WorldSource interface
nodes.rationale: Largest risk was finding a walkable interior; defining the world by interface let a procedural implementation ship first.

nodes.label: Frame time measurement (300 frames, gl.finish)
nodes.rationale: A frame time pinned to a refresh multiple is a v-sync reading, not a cost.

nodes.label: State machine (exploring, answering, paused, completed)
nodes.rationale: Answering must not pause timers or recall hints could never fire.

nodes.label: Three.js exact version pin (0.181.2, HDRLoader, PCFShadowMap)
nodes.norm_label: three.js exact version pin (0.181.2, hdrloader, pcfshadowmap)

nodes.norm_label: working agreement (checks wired to npm scripts)

nodes.label: Memoria 3D Specification
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth; build prompts kept in PROMPTS.md so the coding tool never sees instructions for future checkpoints.

nodes.label: Adaptive resolution (texture upgrade, anisotropy, pixel-ratio ladder)
nodes.norm_label: adaptive resolution (texture upgrade, anisotropy, pixel-ratio ladder)
nodes.rationale: Nothing costs boot time (1k maps at boot, 2k in background) and nothing is raised on a machine that has not demonstrated headroom; ladder never climbs twice to avoid oscillation.

nodes.label: Generate home appearance from room photos
nodes.norm_label: generate home appearance from room photos
nodes.rationale: Appearance matching within the existing house, not photogrammetry; floor plan and furniture stay fixed.

nodes.label: Agent image pipeline (EXIF strip, probe/texture/thumb)
nodes.rationale: probe is the only thing any model sees, worded as a pipeline property so a runtime change cannot widen exposure.

nodes.label: Security (loopback bind, origin allowlist, role-scoped tokens)
nodes.norm_label: security (loopback bind, origin allowlist, role-scoped tokens)

nodes.label: AGENT_TOOL_SCHEMA constrained tool calls
nodes.rationale: 4B models asked politely for JSON sometimes answer in prose; compiling to a GBNF grammar makes invalid shapes impossible. Guarantees shape, not truth.

nodes.label: Prompt layer prompts.ts (version f-2, reasoning steps)
nodes.norm_label: prompt layer prompts.ts (version f-2, reasoning steps)
nodes.rationale: Both jobs fail by answering too early, so each prompt demands named reasoning notes before calls; offline these are required schema fields ahead of calls, online only an instruction.

nodes.label: D-1 Online setup mode deviation
nodes.rationale: Shipped without amending SPEC; kept because caregivers without a capable GPU should still use the feature.

nodes.label: D-2 Serverless key proxy declined
nodes.rationale: Adds a deployable component and a new trust boundary that sees every probe image; revisit when deployed for caregivers at large.

nodes.label: auditDoorways
nodes.rationale: Clearance is measured, never eyeballed; furniture inside a doorway silently makes it impassable.

nodes.label: auditReachability
nodes.rationale: Getting into a room is not being able to move around it; flood-fill from spawn catches sealed floor.

nodes.label: House templates
nodes.rationale: LiDAR unavailable; free-form editor too demanding and unaudited; photoreal reconstruction would invent unseen parts of the home.

nodes.label: Poly Haven texture sets (surfaces and detail)
nodes.norm_label: poly haven texture sets (surfaces and detail)

nodes.label: Template mirroring in layout data
nodes.rationale: Negative scale would reverse winding, door swings and mirror photographs/text.

nodes.label: Export world block (templateId, mirrored, templateVersion)
nodes.rationale: A different house is a different task; attempts comparable only within the same three fields.

nodes.label: Agent configuration (enabled false, setupMode, provider stub)
nodes.norm_label: agent configuration (enabled false, setupmode, provider stub)
nodes.rationale: baseUrl never persisted to localStorage so tampered config cannot express an endpoint.

nodes.label: Completion outcomes (independent, cued, revealed, skipped)
nodes.rationale: Revealed and skipped are never counted as correct; no single score.

nodes.label: Hint ladder (repeat, highlight, guide/reveal)
nodes.rationale: Level 3 must not auto-complete navigate/find, which would skip the measured gameplay.

nodes.label: Telemetry event contract and summary
nodes.rationale: Claim nothing clinical; label 'auxiliary interaction measures — not diagnostic'; answerLatency null on revealed/skipped so a fast reveal never looks like a fast answer.

nodes.label: Memoria 3D camera assistance patch
nodes.rationale: Off by default: with it off, no network, no camera, no observation code loaded.
